lines.t: Alcatraz
This is Alcatraz, the Head Maid's ultra-luxurious hotel resort island.
Ah, let's not get it twisted. This is all because an unexplained (?) tsunami hit the island.
Even under these tough conditions, all the maids united with one heart and mind (?) to begin restoration work.
Of course, a few thoughtless maids caused some trouble along the way, but in the name of love and friendship, I executed—er, resolved it.
And so, one day, as restoration continued smoothly without a single hitch...
*Yawn*
Time to work.
...heard that?
...Huh?
I heard something.
Sandy Beach
Come to think of it, did you hear that rumor?
Huh? What rumor?
You know, that escaped convict Master.
The one who popped out of nowhere and put all of us to work on the restoration.
Huh? Wasn't it the head maid who ordered us to do the restoration work?
<bouten>On the surface</bouten>, sure. But the consensus is that she's actually already been conquered by that Master.
Besides, it's not just her—rumor has it that plenty of regular maids like us have been conquered by him too.
C-Conquered...
Either way, it's certain that Master has recruited quite a few of our fellow maids to his side.
That's how he was able to use his allies to make all of us work on restoration.
T-The escaped convict Master did something that terrifying?!
Only he knows the truth.
Anyway, what matters starts now.
Just how... did he conquer them?
(Gulp...)
This comes directly from a maid who was conquered by Master...
She said what awakened her was a totally ordinary <bouten>massage</bouten>.
......A massage?
Yes, strange, isn't it?
But looking back, she said it was completely different from a normal massage.
It's hard to put into words... but it felt i-incredibly good, apparently...?
Anyway, she said experiencing it yourself is faster. That thing called <bouten>body talk</bouten>.
B-Body talk...
Yes. They call that special massage body talk...
According to the maid who received it herself...
H-H-He does stuff like THAT?!
And that's not all...
......That's what happened.
So teach me body talk.
......What kind of ridiculous rumors are going around about me?!
Phew... Well, whatever. So that's what it was. Man... I sprinted over here for nothing.
You ran? Why?
Never mind that. Anyway, I get what you're saying.
But what does that have to do with you asking me to teach you body talk?
It's a secret.
You promised when we went to catch the maids before.
Fixer, you said if I did what you asked, you'd teach me. Remember?
If I give them that massage, will they become obedient to me?
...Just asking for reference, who are you planning to do it to?

...Mm.
Secret.
You little brat, what are you plotting...
...Well, if you do what I say, I suppose I could teach you.
Okay. I'll do my best.
Wait, did I... say that? My memory is a bit hazy...
I did my best, so teach me.
......Sigh, fine. A man's gotta keep his word.
However.
Since you decided to learn, you better brace yourself.
Body talk... or whatever you wanna call it... it's a technique that has saved my neck countless times since I came to this world.
In other words, it's lightyears away from just randomly kneading someone's body.
You're about to learn an extremely delicate technique... Are you ready for that?
Yeah. I'll do my best.
I’ve already done plenty of prep by following you around.
...Ah, well. I guess you have...
Then let's see what you've got.
Okay. Leave it to me.
How is it, Fixer? Am I doing well?
......! Urgh!! Th-This is...!!!
I kept watching what you did all this time.
How is it? Do you feel conquered by me?
......Uh, yeah.
......! Fixer, what did you just—
I'm dying...! I'm gonna die...!!
Ghahhh! M-My body...!! My body is screaming in agony!!
M-Medic...!! Medic!!!
After that, I got thoroughly patched up in the infirmary.

chat.t: You must've had a rough day today
Should I give you a massage?

o: Are you seriously trying to murder me?

chat.t: I didn't think of doing that

o: Be honest with me
Who put you up to this?

chat.t: I just wanted to do it mys

Don't forget the feel of what you did today

lines.t: Alcatraz
This is Alcatraz, the Head Maid's ultra-luxurious hotel resort island.
Located on the sea of Vermont, an island where every single staff member is a maid...... Ah, did I do this intro already?
Anyway, restoration work was progressing smoothly... around the time I started contemplating life after facing a mortal crisis...
Resort Entrance Under Repair
Sigh, life was so much easier when I was just rounding up maids...
Hah... What can you do? Guess this is just my luck...
...heard that?
...Huh?
Who's slacking off and chatting instead of working?
Sandy Beach
Come to think of it, did you hear that rumor?
Huh? What rumor this time...
You know, that body talk I mentioned before.
The thing the escaped convict Master used to conquer the head maid and our fellow maids...
Ah... Y-Yes.
Everywhere he touched tingled like an electric shock...
And your whole body grew uncontrollably hot...
Uh... Well, yeah. You remember it in quite vivid detail...
I thought you usually weren't interested in rumors.
T-T-T-That's!! U-Um, I just happened to...
A-Anyway! W-What about that body talk...?
Actually... I heard some maids were recently attacked under the guise of it.
Someone approaches saying they'll do body talk, weirdly kneads them all over, and then just leaves...
W-What!!? H-How could someone do something so awful...?!
The weird thing is that not a single one of them will reveal who the culprit is.
Maybe they were threatened into silence...
T-That's... Whoever it is, they sound truly terrifying...
......So, what do you think?
Do you have any idea who the culprit behind those terrifying rumors might be?
It was a fair deal.
Oho, taking it head-on, are we?
Well then, let's hear it.
Yeah. Since that day, I practiced body talk on the maids.
But most of them didn't react well.
So I promised to do it again for them once I master it completely.
......Huh? Why is this surprisingly normal?
Wait, then why did people say they got attacked or silenced?
...Mm. I'm not really sure.
Spill it. What exactly did you do to them?
Mm, well... earlier...
Hii, hii...! Sob, ah...!! Mmmf, haah... haah...
N-Now that I'm here... she won't b-be able to follow me... Ngg, ah...
Hey.
Eeeeek!!!!!!
Running away... problematic.
P-Please spare me! I-I'll do anything!!
...? Mm, then help me with one thing.
I'm practicing body talk. Can I try it on you?
Understood!! T-Then you'll spare my life, right?!
Mm... sure.
......After that, I asked her how it was, and she said she wasn't sure.
So I promised to do it again for her once I master it completely.
Then she asked me to forgive her and promised not to tell anyone.
That's completely different from what you made it sound like, you idiot!!
Don't describe a horror movie like it's a coming-of-age drama!
......Mm. But I really did improve.
It won't hurt anymore. I got the hang of it while trying it on the maids.
The Fixer's body is weaker than other people's, so I practiced that a lot. So...
Give me one more chance.
...Sigh, fine. I get it.
But if I end up in the infirmary again, these lessons end right here. Okay?
Yeah.
Fixer, why are you shaking so much? Are you cold?
W-Who's shaking?! Just s-start already.
Fixer, how is it? It doesn't hurt anymore, right?
Huh? Uh, mm... I mean, yeah, but...
How does it feel? Am I doing well?
Hm... Mmm...
Okay, stop for a second.
Huh?
Let's see... First off... right.
You said when you tried it on the maids before, their reaction wasn't great, right?
...Yeah. They said they weren't sure.
I think I get why they said that now.
What you did this time... how should I put it? It was actually more lukewarm.
You were so obsessed with holding back your strength that the actual <bouten>massage</bouten> didn't feel like anything.
But something definitely improved.
...Huh?
Either way, you definitely controlled your strength.
Now don't forget that feeling, and let me guide you to the next step.
......Then... can I keep going?
Well, at least I avoided the infirmary.
Don't want to? If not, forget it.
...No. I want to keep going.
......Yeah. I want to keep going.
Right, once you've drawn your knife, you gotta at least slice a radish.
Yeah. I'd rather slice meat.
...Uh, sure. Slice all the meat you want.
Then what should I do now, Fixer?
Should I learn massage techniques or something?
No, there's something more important than techniques.
In fact, it might be the most essential part of a massage...
Mm. What is it?

And that is...
<bouten>the heart</bouten>.

o: Hey, where are you right now?
What I mentioned before is ready. Want to do it today?

lines.t: Resort Entrance
Fixer, I'm here. *munch munch*
Wait, already...? It's only been like a minute!
It should take at least twenty minutes to get here from Annex C...?
Yeah. I'm a homunculus.
I ran fast while eating jerky.
...Ah. For a second I thought I was just waiting really fast.
...? Waiting fast? How do you do that?
It's a figure of speech. Whatever, let's just go.
......Mm. Confirmed.
Quiet Beach
...Mm. Fixer.
What exactly are we doing today? You can tell me now.
Today...
I'm going to show you what a proper massage really is.
...Huh? A proper massage?
Yeah, I said before that the most important thing in a massage is the heart.
The same mindset as the <bouten>spirit of service</bouten>, which is most important for a maid...
In other words, you need a maid-like spirit of service before you can give a proper massage.
......Mm. I don't really get it.
Does a maid really need a spirit of service?
...What do you mean? Watch your words, that could get controversial.
Mm. Earlier, you said, Fixer, that the most important thing for a maid is teamwork.
So everyone has to work together and play together, which means any maid who doesn't work gets caught and—
Okay, that's enough small talk.
There's something much more important than minor details right now!!

The important thing is that while I massage you,
I'll carve the spirit of service directly into your body!!
...Mm. Is that really necessary?
I want to learn how to give one.
You can't learn it just by blindly doing it.
Massage... no, body talk is fundamentally about give and take!
Mm... okay. If you say so.
Yeah, I'm doing this for your own good.
Come on, over here. Repairs here are finished, so nobody should come by.
Yeah.
But do we really have to do it in a place like this?
Well, anywhere without distractions is fine, but...
We might make some noise while doing it.
......Mm. Noise?
Well, I'll explain the details while we do it, so let me show you.
Alright, lie down comfortably right here...
Like this?
And if I adjust your posture like this...
Nng... Haah, haah...
How was it? Any thoughts on our body talk?
It was just like the maids said.
A tingling sensation like electricity... my whole body getting hotter and hotter...
Is this what body talk is?
Yeah. That is true body talk.
Even though it's called body talk, it's not literally just talking with your body.
A maid's spirit of service... the Fixer caring for me...
It only becomes true body talk when feelings like that are behind it, right?
Excellent. Are you getting the hang of it now?
Yeah... I think I understand now.
Fixer, can I try it right now?
Uh... right now? Aren't you overdoing it?
You said it yourself. Body talk is about give and take.
So I want to give one to you too, Fixer.
Um... hey, maybe you should calm down first...
I am calmer right now than I've ever been, Fixer.
And I am feeling more threatened for my life right now than I've ever been.
......Fixer, let's talk about this later.
Right now, just let me suck it.
W-Wait—
After that, I got sucked senseless in bed.

lines.t: Ever since the day I taught Claire true body talk...
Alcatraz
Fixer, are you free tonight?
Uh, mm... I guess so.
Take it easy though. I have work tomorrow.
Yeah.
Gaaaaah!! Medic, medic!!
And after that...
Today I'm really confident. I came up with a new method.
This time I'll use my feet.
Feet...? Well, I guess that doesn't sound too bad...
...Sigh, fine. Just this once.
Gaaaaaaah!!! Medic!!!
And the time after that...
Fixer, this time for real.
I tried it on Hinata when she passed by earlier, and it was fine.
Oh, really? That's a relief then.
Wait, w-what's a relief...
...Um, don't tell me I was just a test subject!!?
Heh. How is it now?
......Uh. Is it actually better now?
Yeah. I thought super hard about how to make you feel good.
I'll loosen up the tight spots first. From top to bottom...
Heh... Does this feel good?
I'll keep going... so just relax—
Urgh... Gaaah...
Me... dic...
......That's what happened.
...Ahem, so by any chance...
Did you come here to brag...?
...Mm. No.
I came because I need help.
M-My help? Where in what you just said could you possibly need my—
Ah, ahh? Eh? N-N-No... Don't tell me... M-Me and... t-together...?
...? I don't really get what you mean.
Together? You mean you want to do body talk together?
N-N-No, that's not it—well, not that it isn't, but—!!!!!
U-Um, please forget what I just said...
...Ahem. So... what can I... h-help you with?
Tell me what a maid's <bouten>spirit of service</bouten> is.
Ever since I learned about it, I can't control my strength properly.
I think I misunderstood something, so I came to learn from you.
Um... spirit of service is a bit out of the blue...
The Fixer told me. The most important thing is the heart.
And he said that heart is similar to a maid's spirit of service.
Like a maid caring for her master, the heart to care for someone is what's important.
But I don't think I'm doing it right.
...What do you mean by not doing it right?
...Mm. When the Fixer did it for me, it felt amazing.
But when I did it for the Fixer, he didn't like it.
So I think something is wrong with me, but I don't know what.
It's not like I'm lacking energy or anything.
E-Energy...?
Um... I'm not entirely sure, but to me, it doesn't seem like there's anything wrong with you, Claire.
Didn't you say it was fine when you did it to someone else?
......Mm. That's true.
Then if we ask if the issue lies with Master, that probably isn't it either.
Because you said there was no issue before when you... d-did it with Master.
Then the issue... no, rather than an issue, perhaps something worth considering is...

what has changed since you learned about the spirit of service,
Claire.
What changed?
Yes. Things like that are often something people don't realize themselves, and they're hard to notice.
So instead of looking at Master, you need to look closely at your own heart, Claire.
Things like what you want to do, what you don't want to do... that sort of thing.
......Mm. I see.
In that case...
......Yeah. I understand.
Did that answer all your questions?
...Mm. To some extent.
I'll go now. Thank you. That helped a lot.
Hehe, you're very welcome.
...Hehe, I'm jealous...
Now then, shall I get back to my remaining work?
By the way.
Y-Yes!!?
Don't you have something you want to do too?
I just thought so while listening to you.
I don't know what it is, but you're the one who told me to look closely at my own heart.
Bye then.
What I want to do...

lines.t: Resort Room
Hello, Fixer.
Thanks for working hard today too. Must have been tough, right?
......? U-Uh, yeah. S-Sure.
You sweated a lot. It must have been rough.
Then, do you want to take a bath first?
Huh? Ah, no...?
No, you must take a bath first.
W-What is it? What are you planning?
I'm not up to anything.
But you must take a bath first.
(Hey, anyone can tell you've got an ulterior motive...)
Sigh... Fine, do what you want.
So we're practicing massage after the bath?
No. We're doing it while you take a bath.
...Huh? What does that mean?
I'll do it while you take a bath.
Hey... That's just repeating the exact same thing!
So, you're saying you'll practice massage while I'm taking a bath?
Yeah.
Y-You don't mean...
Everything is ready. All you have to do is show up, Fixer.
H-Hold on! Just in case, I should call a medic first—
You don't need that.
Because this time, I'm really confident.
After that, Claire sucked me completely dry for a while.
And...
Sandy Beach
The ocean breeze is cool. It feels good.
I'm dying over here, though...
...Mmm. Was doing it with me not good?
It's not that it wasn't good... It's just normal to feel exhausted afterwards.
I didn't feel that way. Is it normally like that?
I don't know. Isn't that just because you're a homunculus?
......Fixer, a Homunculus is an ordinary person too.
You're the one saying that?! Think about what you've done up until now!!
...Sigh, well anyway...
What you did this time barely gets a passing grade. Don't get ahead of yourself, though.
You still have a long way to go, so keep working on it.
Yeah.
Anyway, so what did you do to suddenly gain enlightenment?
I just did <bouten>what I wanted to do</bouten>.
......Huh? What you wanted to do?
Before, I thought I had to do it for your sake.
Maids serve their masters, not themselves.
So I did that too.
Well... You don't necessarily have to think of it that way, do you?
Maids probably serve because they enjoy doing it themselves.
Yeah. I didn't realize that at first.
So whenever other thoughts popped up, I put too much force into it.
Thinking I had to do it for your sake made me unable to control my strength.
R-Right... By the way, speaking of other thoughts, what were you thinking...?
It's a secret.
Hey, why is that a secret? It's about time you told me.
I can't tell you yet.
Then when are you going to tell me?
Until I completely master physical communication?
...Wait, you're planning to keep doing this?
Yeah. You're the one who told me to keep working on it because I still have a long way to go.
Ah.
So, even after this summer ends...
Take good care of me, Fixer.
